\"Record information on the building(s): "Tsala tshedimosetso ka dingwe(tse) tsa setlhopha (ditshwantsho tsa kakaretso le tsa boago, bokgoni jwa mafelo a polokelo, jj). Fa go kgonega, neelana ka tshedimosetso e e ka dirisiwang go bopa dipalo." (ISDIAH 5.3.6)
\"Record a short description of the hold: "Tsala tlhaloso e khutshwane ya didirisiwa tsa setlhopha, go tlhalosa gore di ne di bopiwa jang le fa. Neelana ka tshedimosetso ka bogolo jwa didirisiwa, mefuta ya media, pokello ya ditlhogo, jj." (ISDIAH 5.3.7)
\"Record the title and other pertinent d: "Tsala leina le dintlha tse dingwe tse di botlhokwa tsa dithuso tsa go bona tse di phatlaladitsweng le/le tse di sa phatlaladisiwang tse di rulagantsweng ke setlhopha le tsa diphatlhalatsa tse dingwe tse di amegang. \"Record the opening hours of the instit: "Tsala diura tsa go bula tsa setlhopha le matsatsi a phomolo a ngwaga, a selemo le a setjhaba, le ditshwantsho tse dingwe tse di rulagantsweng. \"Record information about travelling to: "Tsala tshedimosetso ka go fofela kwa setlhopheng le dintlha tsa basebedisi ba ba nang le dikgwetlho, go akaretsa ditshwantsho tsa boago, didirisiwa tse di kgethegileng kgotsi didiriswa, parking kgotsi dilift." (ISDIAH 5.4.3)

The whole site is reset every night at 0: Site hinkwaro yi reset every night at 02:20 South African time, kasi cinca hinkwaswo a xi tshama, ni munhu un'wana a wu vona after reset.
